# appdynamics_database_health_rule_violations (Data Source)

Queries health rule violations for one monitored database server within a time range. Like appdynamics_health_rule_violations, this is a reporting/lookup query over historical data, not a list of currently-managed config objects.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appdynamics_database_health_rule_violations" "primary" {
  server_id        = "512"
  time_range_type  = "BEFORE_NOW"
  duration_in_mins = 1440
}

output "violation_count" {
  value = length(data.appdynamics_database_health_rule_violations.primary.violations)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the monitored database server to query violations for (see appdynamics_database_servers).
- `time_range_type` (String) BEFORE_NOW, AFTER_TIME, or BETWEEN_TIMES.

### Optional

- `duration_in_mins` (Number) Required when time_range_type is BEFORE_NOW or AFTER_TIME.
- `end_time` (Number) Epoch milliseconds. Required when time_range_type is BETWEEN_TIMES.
- `start_time` (Number) Epoch milliseconds. Required when time_range_type is BETWEEN_TIMES or AFTER_TIME.

### Read-Only

- `violations` (Attributes List) The violations matching the query. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--violations))

<a id="nestedatt--violations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `violations`

Read-Only:

- `deep_link_url` (String)
- `end_time` (Number) Epoch milliseconds.
- `id` (String)
- `incident_status` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `severity` (String)
- `start_time` (Number) Epoch milliseconds.
